silas_not_rook.text: "Rook kept good clocks. Terrible teeth. Nothing to do with me, Doctor."
silas_not_rook.crack: He is very quiet for a moment. "You could have just asked," he says. "It's Thaddeus. I'm... his. Don't tell Nell I said so."

dolores_no_212.text: "There was never a Hymn 212. A hymnal is a list in order."
dolores_no_212.crack: "...It was retired. We retired it. That is not the same as never." Her hands are shaking. "Please. Not in front of the flowers."

hank_vandals.crack: "Older than June," he says, slowly. "Older than me. It was there when my aunt painted the Chapel hall. Why was I scraping it off?"

harlan_signed.text: "My father signed it. I held the pen."
harlan_signed.crack: "Both. We both did. He wrote the number. I wrote her name. Hattie. It looks so small, in green."

bea_baker.text: "Everything's a little early this year. Funny how it goes."
bea_baker.crack: She sets down the loaf. "You're wearing her very well," she says, softly. "Hon. We should talk."

fitz_nobody.text: "Nobody. A man I'm telling a story about. Different bar."
fitz_nobody.crack: The glass stops turning. "Four notes," Fitz says. "I hum them in my sleep. I don't know why. A man called Ambrose runs a bar that isn't here."
